hook: In the first second a salesman slaps a teen's hand off a red sports car, right in his face, and snaps 'Hands off! Kids don't touch, kids don't test drive.' The public humiliation makes viewers stop to see the kid get even.

scenes.heading: INT. CAR DEALERSHIP — DAY
scenes.look: Sterile, glossy showroom in cold white overhead glare and chrome reflections; the red sports car is the only warm colour, and Kai's hoodie looks small against all the polish.

shots.speaker: Car salesman
shots.line: Hands off! Kids don't touch, kids don't test drive.
shots.action: Kai lays his palm on the red hood and the salesman slaps it away, leaning right into his face.
shots.reaction: Kai's hand jerks back off the hood.
shots.camera: Close two-shot over the gleaming hood, whip-pan up from the slap to the salesman's face, fast push-in

shots.action: Kai flinches, then plants his feet and squares up to the salesman.
shots.reaction: Kai's eyes blink hard, then his jaw sets and his chin lifts.
shots.camera: Close-up on Kai, slight low angle, static

shots.speaker: Kai
shots.action: Kai looks the salesman dead in the eye.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Kai, slow push-in

shots.speaker: Car salesman
shots.line: With what? Birthday money? This car costs more than your parents' house.
shots.action: The salesman laughs and looks Kai up and down, from the hoodie to the backpack.
shots.camera: High-angle over the salesman's shoulder looking down on Kai, then a cut-in close-up on the salesman's sneer

shots.speaker: Kai
shots.action: Kai hitches his backpack strap and doesn't step back.
shots.camera: Tight close-up on Kai, static

shots.speaker: Car salesman
shots.line: Take twenty. I'll be here. Selling to real customers.
shots.action: The salesman waves him off with the back of his hand.
shots.reaction: Eyes rolling as he turns away.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on the salesman, static

shots.action: The salesman turns his back and polishes the hood where Kai touched it.
shots.reaction: Kai watches, fists tightening at his sides.
shots.camera: Insert of the cloth rubbing out the handprint, Kai blurred in the background

scenes.heading: INT. CAR DEALERSHIP — WAITING BENCH — CONTINUOUS
scenes.look: A cold, blue-grey corner by the showroom window with Kai's face lit only by his phone; the salesman stays bright and distant across the floor until the chart flips and warm light floods Kai's face.

shots.action: Kai drops onto the bench by the window and pulls out his phone.
shots.camera: High, isolated wide shot, Kai small on the bench with the car gleaming far away

shots.action: The fomo Home screen lights up on Kai's phone.
shots.camera: Macro insert, phone fills the frame, static

shots.speaker: Kai
shots.action: Kai exhales and leans over the phone.
shots.camera: Close-up on Kai, phone glow on his face

shots.action: Kai taps in and the line drops.
shots.camera: Macro insert, phone fills the frame, static

shots.action: Kai's face falls and he freezes.
shots.reaction: His face drains and his eyes lock on the screen without blinking.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Kai, cold blue light

shots.speaker: Car salesman
shots.line: Bus stop's around the corner, champ.
shots.action: Across the floor, the salesman smirks and calls over his shoulder.
shots.camera: Long-lens medium shot across the showroom, Kai's shoulder soft in the foreground

shots.action: Kai stares at the screen in silence.
shots.camera: Close-up on Kai, static, dead quiet

shots.speaker: Kai
shots.action: Kai whispers to himself, gripping the phone with both hands.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Kai's lips and eyes, slow push-in

shots.action: Kai's thumb hovers over sell on the falling chart, then pulls back.
shots.camera: Macro insert over Kai's thumb on the phone, static

shots.action: The showroom wall clock's minute hand jumps.
shots.camera: Insert of the wall clock, snap zoom

shots.action: Kai's knee bounces under the phone.
shots.camera: Low insert on Kai's bouncing knee, handheld

shots.action: The chart rockets up on Kai's phone.
shots.camera: Macro insert, phone fills the frame, static

shots.action: Kai looks up from the phone, now lit warm.
shots.reaction: His eyes go wide, then a slow grin spreads across his face.
shots.camera: Close-up on Kai, slow push-in as the light shifts from blue to warm

scenes.heading: INT. CAR DEALERSHIP — MOMENTS LATER
scenes.look: Warm gold showroom spotlights and a glowing red car; customers and staff in the background stop and turn to watch the reversal.

shots.action: Kai's phone, showing the chart up, is thrust up into the salesman's face as Kai walks straight up to him.
shots.camera: Tracking insert, phone held up and filling the frame, the salesman's face blurred behind it

shots.action: The salesman reads the screen and freezes.
shots.reaction: His jaw drops and stays hanging, eyes bulging, and he holds it.
shots.camera: Close-up on the salesman, snap zoom

shots.speaker: Kai
shots.action: Kai lowers the phone and tilts his head.
shots.camera: Low-angle medium close-up on Kai, static

shots.speaker: Car salesman
shots.line: Sir! Can I get you a coffee? A test drive?
shots.action: The salesman snaps upright and gestures eagerly toward the car while background customers turn to stare.
shots.reaction: A desperate, too-wide grin and a sweaty brow.
shots.camera: Medium shot on the salesman, fast push-in, onlookers soft behind

shots.speaker: Kai
shots.action: Kai throws the salesman's words back at him.
shots.reaction: The salesman's grin freezes and cracks.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder close-up on Kai, low angle

shots.speaker: Kai
shots.action: Kai holds out his open palm.
shots.camera: Insert of Kai's open palm, the salesman's face soft behind it, static

shots.action: The salesman drops the keys into Kai's palm and Kai slides into the driver's seat of the red car.
shots.reaction: The salesman slumps with his shoulders down.
shots.camera: Low-angle tracking shot following Kai into the car

shots.speaker: Kai
shots.line: Your move. Find it on fomo.
shots.action: From the driver's seat Kai looks to camera and holds up his phone showing the fomo Home screen.
shots.camera: Slow push-in on Kai through the windshield, direct to camera, phone screen readable

clips.seam: Hard cut to moments later as Kai confronts the salesman.
